newsitem.title: USA: U.S. teen accused of murdering her newborn.
newsitem.headline: U.S. teen accused of murdering her newborn.

text.p: A teenager who delivered her baby in a bathroom during her senior prom was charged on Tuesday with murder after an autopsy indicated the infant was asphyxiated, authorities said.
Melissa Drexler, 18, had kept her pregnancy secret when she went to her senior prom on June 6.
There she gave birth to a boy in a bathroom of a banquet hall in Aberdeen, New Jersey, authorities said. She then went back to the dance.
A short time later, a maintenance worker discovered the baby's body in a garbage bag.
"The child was alive when he was born," said John Kaye, Monmouth County prosecutor.
A report by the local medical examiner indicated the baby died from asphyxiation and the death was ruled a homicide, Kaye said.
The teen surrendered to authorities on Tuesday morning, he said. She was charged with murder and endangering a child.
